integrity: The mathematical proof and supporting numerical checks are described separately; the exact asymptotic is an analytic result, not a finite-experiment inference. Historical priority is qualified by a related inaccessible 2001 source. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Fixed weight alpha>-1; a single radial unimodular boundary chirp on the analytic weighted unit-disk Bergman spaces only; no analogous assertion for arbitrary oscillatory symbols or growing alpha.
title: Stretched-exponential cancellation for reciprocal-phase weighted Bergman moments
